brand: Bomber (Thomas K. L. Ind. de Alto-Falantes)
terms_note: robots.txt disallows only WooCommerce/admin paths; no terms of use found. Manuals and pages read one at a time 2026-11-21/22. Numbers only. Also present in the BuildBass MIT bundle already in the app; values here re-read from the maker's manuals.

sources.doc: 3.27.431 manual, Woofer 12" Atrack 5K 2 ohms 2500 W RMS

drivers.notes: Brazilian 'woofer' for car bass/midbass walls: high Fs, small Vas; meets the power and load rule but is not a deep-bass subwoofer. Le 0.45 mH at 1 kHz (0.24 mH at 10 kHz); Zmin 2.92 ohm; Cms 0.03 mm/N; reference efficiency 0.69 %; T/S 'sensitivity' 90.6 dB SPL (condition not stated, not in spl fields). Xmax, cut-out and depth appear only in a drawing table whose numbers could not be matched to labels with certainty; left out. Manual also gives suggested vented boxes (round, rectangular, triangular port) in a table not transcribed.

sources.doc: 3.27.429 manual, Woofer 15" Atrack 5K 2 ohms 2500 W RMS

drivers.notes: Brazilian 'woofer' for car bass/midbass walls: high Fs, small Vas; meets the power and load rule but is not a deep-bass subwoofer. Le 0.40 mH at 1 kHz; Zmin 2.75 ohm; Cms 0.04 mm/N; efficiency 1.49 %; T/S sensitivity 94.2 dB SPL (condition not stated). Xmax/dimensions left out (drawing table not mappable).

sources.doc: 3.27.447 manual, Woofer 12" Atrack 6.5K 2 ohms 3250 W RMS

drivers.notes: Brazilian 'woofer' for car bass/midbass walls: high Fs, small Vas; meets the power and load rule but is not a deep-bass subwoofer. Bl printed '13,91' without unit (T m assumed); Mms printed '141,5' without unit (g assumed); Cms 0.028 mm/N; Zmin 3.07 ohm; T/S sensitivity 90.85 dB SPL. Xmax/dimensions left out.

sources.doc: 3.27.403 / 3.27.365 Rev. 00 manual, Subwoofer Bicho Papão 5K 4+4 ohms 2500 W RMS

drivers.notes: Re printed '2,84 + 2,87' ohm (per coil; re_ohm = first coil). Power: 2500 W RMS, 5000 W 'competição'. File name says 14 inch, product listing says 15 inch; size left empty (UNVERIFIED). Cms 0.08 mm/N; Le 2.63 mH at 10 kHz; efficiency 0.33 %. Xmax is the manual's 'deslocamento máx. pico' (peak, one way). Final load 2 ohm with coils in parallel.

no_ts_published.model: Subwoofer 15" Bicho Papão 2000 W RMS 2+2 ohms
no_ts_published.note: DVC 2+2 ohm (final 1 or 4 ohm). Manual https://www.bomber.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/3.27.140_Manual-Sub-BP-2000W.pdf has the T/S table as an image (no text); product page table values could not be matched to labels. Sealed box 40 L suggested for SWBP15-2000 (manual).

excluded_notes: Bicho Papão Competição 12"/15" (5000 W 'competição', 2500 W programme, 1250 W RMS-AES per https://www.bomber.com.br/produto/subwoofer-12-bicho-papao-competicao-5000-wrms-2-ohms/) excluded: RMS (AES) below 2000 W. Atrack 4 ohm versions (5K, 6.5K, Bass 4K/6K) excluded: single 4 ohm coil cannot give 2/1/0.5 ohm.
